integrity: The proof exhausts the four possible center labels and derives the exact admissible ordered label pairs on every triangle page. Independence of distinct pages then gives four factorized contributions. The positive-support condition and the center-zero defense are checked separately, including the r>=2 boundary. A standalone brute-force verifier tests the defining conditions directly for r=2,3,4 and matches every coefficient, minimum value, minimum-function count, and total count.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to friendship graphs F_r with r at least two; the single triangle is excluded.
The scalar value gamma_tdR(F_r)=4 is already implied by published universal-vertex theory and is not claimed as new.
The new content is the all-function center-state classification, complete weight enumerator, total count, and exact minimum-function census.
Finite exhaustive verification for r=2,3,4 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed friendship-graph enumeration may exist despite targeted searches.
